description: Dark Mode Bio-Tech Variant - Swiss & High-Contrast with genetic focus

layout.spacing: Generous paddings (p-6, p-8) for deep-dive sections. Dense padding (p-4) for data tables and widgets.
layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data and copy. Grid items use align-items: start with align-self: stretch for consistent heights.

surfaces_and_components.tracing_beam_card: Apply to Premium Deep Dives (Longevity, Mind). Use a 1px glowing primary_action border.

buttons.primary: bg-[#3366FF] hover:bg-[#2952CC] text-white border-none rounded-md px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border border-[#3366FF]/50 text-[#3366FF] hover:bg-[#3366FF]/10 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] transition-colors

surfaces_and_components.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-white/10 rounded-md focus:border-[#3366FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#3366FF] text-white
surfaces_and_components.tables: w-full text-left. Th: text-xs font-['IBM_Plex_Mono'] text-[#A0A0AB] uppercase pb-3 border-b border-white/10. Td: py-3 border-b border-white/5 font-['IBM_Plex_Sans'].

data_visualization.charts: Use Recharts. No filled areas to maintain sleekness. Stroke width 2. Glow effect using drop-shadow on SVG lines. Colors: #3366FF, #00E676, #FFC400.
data_visualization.ancestry_map: Abstract visual representation. Use a dark dotted background or Recharts ScatterChart to plot geo-proxies, avoiding standard overly-complex map svgs if unneeded.

pages_and_features.dashboard_home: Bento grid layout. Top bar with 'Bundus Assistant' summary panel. Middle section: Interactive Ancestry Map (col-span-8) + Precision Health Panel (col-span-4).
pages_and_features.trait_deep_dives: Scrollable analytical sections. Longevity (FOXO3), Mind & Temperament (COMT). Use distinct iconography and progress/meter bars for trait expression.
pages_and_features.dna_explorer: Data-heavy terminal-style table. Columns: RSID, Chromosome, Position, Genotype, Impact. Use Mono font for RSIDs and Genotypes.
pages_and_features.auth_and_upload: Center-aligned glassmorphism card over the hero background image. Dropzone with dashed border and subtle hover state.

tone_and_copy.style: Calm, precise, competent, highly scientific but accessible.
examples: Good morning. Your DNA data indicates a rapid caffeine metabolism (CYP1A2). Adjusting intake timing is recommended for optimal REM sleep.
Your longevity markers (FOXO3) show a favorable expression for cellular repair.

images.description: High-end glowing DNA helix in dark void for Auth or Upload splash screen.
Microscopic cell structure texture. Use as a low opacity (5-10%) background image in large Deep Dive cards.
Artistic rendering of a DNA strand with particle effects against a dark background, for trait illustrations.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a kebab-case role-based data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-dna-button', data-testid='trait-search-input')
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets standards against dark slate backgrounds. Use text-[#FAFAFA] for primary data, never #FFFFFF or #000000 flatly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Control Room' dense grid strategy for the dashboard.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for crisp, technical icons.
Implement charts using Recharts with dark mode customization (stroke-based, no fills).
Build the UI directly with Tailwind classes and standard accessible HTML elements. If using Shadcn, heavily strip its default Vercel-look to match this Dark Swiss aesthetic.
Include a 'Bundus Assistant' sticky or fixed summary panel that provides plain-text interpretation of the charts.
Ensure the DNA Explorer table handles large simulated data cleanly (use overflow-y-auto and sticky headers).
